final_text:
- Workflow orchestration latency was studied in heterogeneous GPU clusters across 140 scheduled jobs.  
- Median orchestration overhead was 18ms and the 95th percentile was 60ms, and overhead scaled sub-linearly with job count.  
- 70% of overhead was attributed to scheduler queue contention and the remainder to checkpoint serialization.
